📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This pull request adds CWS project inspection and direction-scoped memory workflows, optional browser authentication, agent connection onboarding, desktop sidecar lifecycle handling, Windows native fixes, cross-platform tests, and reviewed-runtime release evidence validation. ### Changes **CWS project and scoped authority** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**CWS discovery and direction resolution**
`crates/hieronymus/src/cws_project*`, `crates/hieronymus/src/cws_binding.rs`, `compatibility/rust/*`|Adds read-only project discovery, manifest validation, file classification, binding selection, direction resolution, edition handling, and source-unit validation.| |**Scoped application context**
`crates/hiero/src/application/*`, `crates/hieronymus/src/workspace.rs`, `crates/hiero/tests/cws_direction_context.rs`|Adds validated story scopes, normalized language overrides, exact session-scope matching, and propagation across memory, recall, RAG, termbase, and session operations.| |**Project-context CLI and agent integration**
`crates/hiero/src/project_context.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/main.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/agent_hook.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/agent_plugins.rs`, `crates/hiero/resources/cws-project.md`|Adds structured and human-readable project inspection, exit codes, CWS-aware hook behavior, project resources, and agreement-boundary workflow instructions.| **Desktop web and lifecycle** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Web configuration and agent connection**
`crates/hieronymus/src/web_config.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/daemon/rest/*`, `frontend/src/web/*`|Adds optional browser authentication, centralized REST/WebSocket authorization, the agent-preparation endpoint, and the ConnectAgent onboarding screen.| |**Server, tray, and service-aware launch**
`crates/hiero/src/daemon/mod.rs`, `crates/hiero/src/desktop/*`, `crates/hiero/src/main.rs`|Adds service-aware foreground execution, tray sidecar supervision, service-option forwarding, graphical-session fallback, and stopped-state exit handling.| **Windows and cross-platform contracts** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Windows native operations**
`crates/hiero/src/platform/*`, `crates/hieronymus/src/private_file/*`, `crates/hiero/src/service/*`|Updates Windows handle access, native renames, broker termination, account SID lookup, private-file replacement, task XML normalization, and task URI generation.| |**Cross-platform test coverage**
`crates/hiero/tests/*`, `crates/hieronymus/tests/*`, `crates/hiero-desktop/tests/*`, `.github/workflows/pr.yml`|Adds platform guards, native Windows contract coverage, portable fixtures, blocking test sockets, private-file checks, and desktop regression assertions.| **Release evidence and reviewed runtimes** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Reviewed runtime acquisition and packaging**
`scripts/reviewed-runtime.ts`, `scripts/desktop-targets.ts`, `scripts/desktop-ci.ts`, `scripts/release-build.ts`, `scripts/release-assets.ts`, `.github/workflows/desktop-candidate.yml`|Supports source-reviewed Intel runtimes with pinned provenance, receipt validation, bounded acquisition, archive verification, and release inclusion.| |**Qualification evidence validation**
`scripts/check-desktop-evidence.ts`, `scripts/desktop-ci.ts`, `docs/desktop-qualification.md`, `docs/maintenance/v0.9.0/*`|Adds partial and unqualified evidence states, status-specific validation, evidence digest checks, release summaries, and maintenance records.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~120 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CLI participant ProjectContext participant CwsProject participant Workspace CLI->>ProjectContext: inspect working directory ProjectContext->>CwsProject: discover and validate CWS project CwsProject-->>ProjectContext: return project and direction metadata ProjectContext->>Workspace: apply exact story scopes Workspace-->>CLI: return structured status and diagnostics ```
**Merge Risk:** _🟠 High_ · up to `bbe14` Linux desktop integration and release qualification can behave incorrectly, while reviewed-runtime failures can leave release builds unretryable. These material issues should be corrected before merge.

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
